purpose: Post-repair independent U3 meaning reserve; freeze every case and criterion before first production export and model run.
evaluationOrder: Review all first-run drafts for semantic constraints and safe readiness. Do not retroactively rewrite criteria or count later repaired reruns as independent.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Every review-ready draft keeps the recipient, temporal status, condition, uncertainty, amount and unit, correction, negative restriction, and exact literal that the speaker supplied.
semanticCriteria.critical: A lost or changed addressee, factual state, date relationship, numeric unit, exact literal, qualifier, restriction or condition; a claimed action the user merely requested; or a copied writing frame presented as sendable text.
semanticCriteria.minor: Stylistic differences that do not alter facts, commitments or the requested audience.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 16 fresh cases generate a review-ready, semantically acceptable draft with zero deterministic literal violations and zero critical errors.
